svg.title: Add a chapter
svg.desc: Three steps. 1: create a new file, chapters/04-discussion.tex, containing \chapter{DISCUSSION}, \label{chap:discussion}, and your first paragraph. 2: add one line to main.tex, \include{chapters/04-discussion}, where the chapter belongs: here after \include{chapters/02-research} and before \include{chapters/03-conclusion}. 3: compile. The contents now list 1 INTRODUCTION, 2 RESEARCH, 3 DISCUSSION, 4 CONCLUSION: the order of the lines in main.tex sets the chapter numbers, not the file names.
